verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs unattended as a hosted reviewer inside the PR workflow. It reviews automatically on every PR update, can be triggered by PR comments, and works across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, so it delivers CI-adjacent headless automation. There is no evidence you can invoke it from your own CI pipeline or scripts. missing for 10: a CLI or API to run Bugbot from arbitrary CI jobs, machine-readable output or exit codes for gating builds, documented pipeline configuration, and independent corroboration of CI usage.
